name: btc_regime_label_design_bullbearchop
status: PRE-REGISTERED — Stage 0 label-quality battery, no learning, no PnL read
what_is_different_about_this_line: Every regime line closed on 2026-08-08 held the LABEL fixed and varied the CLASSIFIER. This one varies the label definition itself and asks which 3-state (bull/bear/chop) labelling is best. The incumbent oracle has NO chop state at all — it forces a directional call on every bar, including bars that are genuinely undecidable.

the_measurement_problem_stated_up_front.problem: A label cannot be scored against an oracle, because the label IS the oracle. There is no ground truth for 'was this really chop'.
the_measurement_problem_stated_up_front.resolution: Score labels on properties that do not need an external reference: does the labelling SEPARATE outcomes, does that separation PERSIST out of sample against a random-relabelling null, is it PERSISTENT enough to act on, and is it BALANCED. The separation-persistence gate is the one that has actually discriminated in this project — it is what killed the direction differential (survives train->VAL 84-96%, dies train->OOS 36-52%).

principled_anchor_for_chop.idea: chop should mean 'the state where trading does not pay', which makes the threshold a CONSEQUENCE of costs rather than a free parameter — repairing the incumbent label's arbitrariness.

two_costs_that_must_both_be_paid.confirmation_tax: 2*theta — the price move a CAUSAL detector must observe before it knows the wave turned. At theta=0.5% that is 1.00%.

principled_anchor_for_chop.capturable_amplitude: net = wave_amplitude - 2*theta - trading_cost. A wave with net <= 0 is unmonetisable no matter how well it is detected, so it IS chop by construction.
principled_anchor_for_chop.immediate_consequence_to_check: the theta=0.005 family has median wave amplitude 0.97% against a confirmation tax of 1.00% alone — under a cost-aware definition nearly the WHOLE theta=0.5% wave family should classify as chop, which would explain directly why the frozen detector cannot pay.

label_families.note: incumbent — no chop state, the baseline every candidate must justify itself against
wave direction if amplitude >= A else chop
THE COST-AWARE ONE — direction if (amplitude - 2*theta - cost) >= margin else chop
Kaufman ER = |net move| / sum|bar moves| over a TRAILING window; direction by sign of the net move if ER >= e else chop
chop if trailing window range < r, else direction by sign of the net move
chop if the wave is shorter than D bars

causality_note_worth_reporting: The ER and range-band families are computed on TRAILING windows, so they are causal BY CONSTRUCTION — they need no detector at all. The entire detector enterprise exists only because the zigzag label is retrospective. If a causal label family separates outcomes as well as a retrospective one, it collapses label+detector into a single object and removes detection lag from the problem.

gates.G1_cost_validity: in chop bars the median capturable move must be <= 0, and in bull/bear bars > 0. This is the definition's own claim and it must hold OOS, not just where it was constructed.
gates.G2_separation_persists: forward-return ordering bull > chop > bear must hold on TRAIN and still hold on OOS, and the OOS effect must beat a random-relabelling null (circular shift of the state vector, preserving state counts and run structure, R=200). THIS IS THE HEADLINE GATE.
gates.G4_persistence: median run >= a floor derived from that label's OWN median wave (one quarter of it), not a floor carried over from another label
gates.G5_coverage_balance: chop occupancy in [15%, 60%] — a label whose chop swallows 81% (the retired HMM's behaviour last week) or 0% (the incumbent) is degenerate
gates.G3_learnability_deferred: whether a causal detector can recover the label is a SECOND stage, run only on labels that survive G1/G2/G4/G5. Testing learnability first would repeat the mistake of optimising a detector for a label with no validated value.

explicitly_not_in_this_stage: no PnL or MDD is computed
scope: A label that passes still needs a consumer. The detector axis currently has none — accuracy went 61.3 -> 68.4% with zero entry-PnL movement and the last candidate consumer closed the same day. What a cost-aware chop state could plausibly buy is an ABSTENTION rule (do not trade here), which is a different and cheaper claim than a directional edge.
